title: Android发布 (移动开放生态的崛起)
title_en: Launch of Android (Rise of the Open Mobile Ecosystem)

video.title: Android：如何征服智能手机行业

summary.text: 2008年9月23日，Google联合T-Mobile和HTC在纽约发布了世界上第一款Android手机——T-Mobile G1（又名HTC Dream）。这不仅是一款新手机的发布，更是一个名为“开放手持设备联盟”（Open Handset Alliance）的宏大战略的落地。与Apple严格控制软硬件的封闭花园不同，Google采取了类似微软Windows的策略：免费开源Android系统给所有手机厂商使用。这一策略虽然导致了早期的体验碎片化，但迅速换来了市场的爆发式普及，使Android最终成为全球市场份额第一的移动操作系统。
summary.text_en: On September 23, 2008, Google, in partnership with T-Mobile and HTC, unveiled the world's first Android phone—the T-Mobile G1 (aka HTC Dream)—in New York. This was not just a phone launch, but the realization of a grand strategy called the 'Open Handset Alliance'. Unlike Apple's walled garden where software and hardware are strictly controlled, Google adopted a strategy similar to Microsoft Windows: licensing Android for free and open-sourcing it to all phone manufacturers. While this led to early fragmentation, it rapidly secured explosive market adoption, eventually making Android the dominant mobile OS by global market share.
key_points: 第一款商用设备是T-Mobile G1 (HTC Dream)
核心策略是“开源”，由开放手持设备联盟 (OHA) 推动
基于Linux内核构建，允许厂商深度定制
引入了下拉通知栏 (Notification Drawer) 等标志性功能
主要目标是确保Google搜索和服务在移动时代的入口
key_points_en: First commercial device was the T-Mobile G1 (HTC Dream)
Core strategy was 'Open Source', driven by the Open Handset Alliance (OHA)
Built on the Linux kernel, allowing deep customization by manufacturers
Introduced iconic features like the Notification Drawer
Primary goal was to secure the gateway for Google Search and services in the mobile era

story.text: Android的故事是科技史上著名的“急转弯”。2005年Google收购Android Inc.时，安迪·鲁宾（Andy Rubin）团队正在开发一款代号为“Sooner”的原型机，它长得非常像黑莓，拥有全键盘和小屏幕，不支持触摸。然而，当2007年乔布斯掏出iPhone时，鲁宾在出租车里看呆了，他惊呼：“天哪，我们得推倒重来！”（Holy crap, we have to start over.）团队忍痛放弃了开发了两年的Sooner，紧急转向代号为“Dream”的触屏项目。为了保险起见（也是因为当时技术不成熟），第一代G1虽然有了触摸屏，但依然保留了一个滑盖物理键盘，这成为了它独特的标志。
story.text_en: The story of Android features a famous 'U-turn' in tech history. When Google acquired Android Inc. in 2005, Andy Rubin's team was developing a prototype codenamed 'Sooner', which looked very much like a BlackBerry with a full keyboard, small screen, and no touch support. However, when Jobs unveiled the iPhone in 2007, Rubin was stunned watching it in a cab, exclaiming, 'Holy crap, we have to start over.' The team painfully scrapped two years of work on Sooner and urgently pivoted to a touchscreen project codenamed 'Dream'. To play it safe (and due to immature tech at the time), the first-generation G1, while featuring a touchscreen, still retained a slide-out physical keyboard, which became its unique trademark.

fun_facts.text: Android著名的绿色机器人Logo（Bugdroid）是由设计师Irina Blok设计的。她的灵感竟然来自厕所门上的男女标志——她只是给那个火柴人加上了两根天线并把它变成了绿色。
fun_facts.text_en: The famous green Android robot logo (Bugdroid) was designed by Irina Blok. Her inspiration actually came from restroom signs—she just added two antennas to the stick figure and turned it green.

fun_facts.text: Android的系统版本代号一直以甜点命名，并且按字母顺序排列：Cupcake (1.5), Donut (1.6), Eclair (2.0)...直到Android 10，Google才因为“全球化理解困难”放弃了这个传统。
fun_facts.text_en: Android version codenames were traditionally named after desserts in alphabetical order: Cupcake (1.5), Donut (1.6), Eclair (2.0)... It wasn't until Android 10 that Google dropped this tradition due to 'global understanding difficulties'.

simple_explanation.text:
如果说iPhone是精美的“封闭花园”，只有买门票（买苹果手机）才能进去玩；
Android就是“城市广场”，谁都可以在这里摆摊（制造手机），虽然有时候会乱一点，但它热闹、便宜，而且无处不在。
它是手机界的Windows。

applications.title: 通知中心 (Notification Drawer)
applications.text: 这是Android对移动交互最大的贡献之一。从屏幕顶部向下滑动查看所有消息的设计，极其高效，后来连iOS也不得不“借鉴”了这一功能。
applications.text_en: One of Android's greatest contributions to mobile interaction. The design of swiping down from the top to see all messages was so efficient that even iOS eventually had to 'borrow' it.

applications.title: 桌面小部件 (Widgets)
applications.text: Android允许在桌面上直接放置日历、天气等动态信息块，而不需要进入App。这体现了其“信息优先”的设计哲学。
applications.text_en: Android allowed placing dynamic info blocks like calendars and weather directly on the home screen without opening apps, reflecting its 'information-first' design philosophy.

impact.text: Android完成了智能手机的“民主化”。通过免费授权，它让三星、小米、华为等厂商能够以极低的成本制造智能手机，将价格打到了iPhone的几分之一。这使得智能手机迅速普及到了发展中国家和低收入人群。如今，全球超过70%的智能手机运行着Android系统。它不仅保住了Google在移动互联网的广告霸权，也成为了连接全球数十亿人的基础设施。
impact.text_en: Android achieved the 'democratization' of the smartphone. By licensing for free, it enabled manufacturers like Samsung, Xiaomi, and Huawei to build smartphones at very low cost, driving prices down to a fraction of the iPhone. This rapidly spread smartphones to developing countries and low-income populations. Today, over 70% of global smartphones run Android. It not only secured Google's ad dominance in the mobile internet but became the infrastructure connecting billions of people.

influenced_by.contribution: Linux内核（Android底层直接使用了Linux内核，这解决了硬件驱动适配的巨大难题）
influenced_by.contribution_en: Linux Kernel (Android used the Linux kernel at its core, solving the massive headache of hardware driver compatibility)

influenced_by.contribution: iPhone（iPhone的发布直接迫使Android重构了整个交互逻辑，转向全触屏设计）
influenced_by.contribution_en: iPhone (The launch of the iPhone forced Android to completely refactor its interaction logic, pivoting to a full-touchscreen design)

influenced.contribution: 三星Galaxy（Android给了三星对抗苹果的武器，使其成为全球最大的手机制造商）
influenced.contribution_en: Samsung Galaxy (Android gave Samsung the weapon to fight Apple, making it the world's largest phone manufacturer)

influenced.contribution: TikTok（Android在发展中国家的海量用户基础，是TikTok等应用能获得十亿级用户的关键）
influenced.contribution_en: TikTok (The massive user base of Android in developing countries was key for apps like TikTok to reach billion-scale users)

influence_chain.legacy_text: be together. not the same. (和而不同)

quiz.question: Android最初是为哪种设备开发的操作系统？
quiz.question_en: What kind of device was Android originally developed for?
quiz.explanation: 安迪·鲁宾最初创办Android Inc.时，是想做一个“智能相机的操作系统”，以此来连接电脑。但后来他发现相机市场在萎缩，于是才转向了手机操作系统。幸好他转了。
quiz.explanation_en: When Andy Rubin founded Android Inc., he intended to build an 'operating system for smart cameras' to connect to PCs. But he later realized the camera market was shrinking, so he pivoted to mobile phone OS. Luckily he did.
